completeness.why: Forecast, rule-action sync, posting and preview now pass their raw amount to the existing getScheduledAmount; the budget template calls it for the range arithmetic with an explicit rounding flag but keeps its own op === 'isbetween' ? helper : value dispatch, so the numeric case is still decided at the site.

interface.why: Reuses the existing exported helper and makes the template's halve-the-rounded-sum inconsistency an explicit named parameter, though it is a third positional boolean (called as false, true) rather than a clearer option or mode.
